method: Flags left by audit-prices after comparing the dividends implied by Adjusted Close with the pinned DoltHub dividend table and SEC dividends per share. An entry accepts only the exact ticker, check, date and values; a new or changed flag still needs review. Amounts are per share at the traded price, fiscal_year amounts on the share basis at the period end.
